name: Rainbow Slider
author: rainbowslider

sections.description:
Rainbow Slider is the most lightweight and efficient way to create sliders using the Elementor Page Builder. No need to learn complex slider plugins. Just design your slides using Elementor’s drag-and-drop interface, and this plugin will convert them into a beautiful, touch-friendly Swiper Slider.

Now with Elementor Container (Flexbox & Grid) Support!

Key Features:

  • Drag & Drop Design: Use Elementor to design each slide.
  • Universal Support: Works with old Sections, new Flexbox Containers, and Grid Containers.
  • Auto Height: Automatically adjusts height based on slide content.
  • Live Preview: Works perfectly inside the Elementor Editor.
  • Zero Bloat: Only loads scripts where the shortcode is used.
  • Touch Friendly: Fully responsive and mobile-optimized.

How it works:

  1. Go to Rainbow Slider > Add New.
  2. Design your slides using Elementor (Each Section/Container becomes a slide).
  3. Copy the shortcode (e.g., [rainbow_slider id='123']).
  4. Paste it anywhere on your site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rainbow-slider directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Rainbow Slider menu to create your first slider.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with Elementor Free?

Yes, it works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Elementor Pro versions.

Can I use Elementor Flexbox Containers?

Yes! Starting from version 3.0.0, this plugin fully supports Elementor Sections, Flexbox Containers, and Grid Containers.

How do I create slides?

Simply create a new Rainbow Slider post. Inside Elementor, every main Section or Container (Parent) you add will act as a single slide.

Why is the slider not showing in the editor?

Ensure you are using the latest version of the plugin. We have added a live preview feature that works inside the Elementor editor when you use the shortcode widget.

Is it responsive?

Yes, since it uses Swiper.js and Elementor’s native responsiveness, your slider will look great on Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop.
